trigger.description: A query needs a cached peer body, but the inbound mesh policy decision has bodyFetchAllowed=false, so ee keeps the peer material metadata-only and reports the policy-gated body-fetch denial without exposing peer body content.
setup_commands: ee mesh peer add --workspace . --peer peer_mesh_metadata_only --grant metadata --deny body --json

expected_emission.repair_string: Grant the peer body lane only if the operator intends to expose remote body material; otherwise use metadata-only context.
